# `csharp_blank_lines_after_file_scoped_namespace_directive`

Blank lines after a file-scoped namespace declaration.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `1`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
using System;

namespace N;
public class Widget { }
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
using System;

namespace N;
public class Widget { }
```
:::

::::

*Curb recognises this key but does not yet reformat this construct — Before and After are identical.*
